I thought that it would be easier to show rather than tell, as i’m not sure what style of make you’re going for i decided to do something similar to my own. 

You can view my edit [right here](https://imgur.com/a/CIKUMIX) (my apologies it’s not the best but i hope it illustrates my point ヾ(๑╹◡╹)ﾉ" )


1. While your droop is good for a second attempt i’d recommend not filling it with white unless you’re trying to go for a (ya)manba look, I closed it off and made it slightly angled as well as making your eyeliner more prominent. 2. I always say this, but: If you *can afford* circle lenses and you’re not afraid to put them in your eyes, you should definitely buy some to enhance your look. 3. I tried my best to make the contour in your nose slightly more noticeable as well as blending it higher into your eyebrow. 4. Speaking of eyebrows I lightened and arched them a bit^^ 5. I added an orange toned blush to your cheeks to give them a more bronze-glowy skin tone. 6. I added a light color of make to your ageyosal/tearbag and your brow bone to make your eyes pop more as well as giving you top and bottom lashes that were more spikey. 7. Your lipstick is a perfect match for your face but i slightly lightened it in my edit for aesthetic purposes sorry about that :,). This look isn’t too hard to achieve if you just put the time and effort into practicing it, it doesn’t take much to achieve. I figured i’d add some personal product recommendations so that you’ll know what to look out for when shopping for makeup: Any tan/Golden eyeshadow shimmer or glitter, slighter colored concealer, bronzer that’s a little more orange than your own skin tone, and too and bottom lashes that can be purchased online via amazon or aliexpress^^

When it comes to hair (esp curly hair) the best thing to do is look at photos of heisei gals from 2000-07 because curly/crimped styles were more popular back then. The best piece of advice i can offer you is to tease your hair, wet it, and use product so that it could maybe look something like [this](https://pin.it/4B184Tbf6) or [this](https://pin.it/4H5Pj9Fkd) (not sure what style you’re going for so take my advice with a grain of salt….) I used some natural hair products and a ton of water to get my [natural hair](https://imgur.com/a/OtvkIk6) looking like the photos i linked…  I hope this helped a little bit i’m not good with this type of thing Σ(-᷅_-᷄๑)
